components.description: Time slot — one delivery or booking window (60 high, size/control/7). Selected = accent/default; Disabled = full; Express = fastest option with a fee.

components.description: Time slot picker — choose a delivery or booking window: day switch (Segmented control) + grid of Time slots (3 per row on mobile) + a note. Express slot first. Lives in a Bottom sheet or inline in checkout.
